messages:
Omar: Heads-up: noticed invoice-preview vs live-invoice mismatch for three tenants after the canary that added dynamic SKU overrides. Preview shows steady $0.02/token, live spikes to $0.035. filing here before people notice.
Tessa: saw it too. A/B experiment injects header `X-Price-Override` for certain routes; resolver v2 now surfaces that as higher precedence. Preview pipeline ignores header for projection, so preview != reality.
Diego: ops-bot: canary started route-resolver:v2-abtest at 1715399800 -> 6%
ops-bot: Canary id=cr-2026-03-22-011 started (6%)
metering-bot: sample billing_event (live): {tenant: \"artlab\", tokens: 1200, route: \"fast-embeds\", X-Price-Override: \"premium\", price_per_token: 0.035} -> preview still shows standard 0.02
Omar: quick query to find events where preview_price != applied_live_price in last hour.
Tessa: running: 
```
SELECT tenant, count(*) mismatches, avg(live_price - preview_price) avg_delta
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '60 minutes' AND preview_price IS NOT NULL AND live_applied_price IS NOT NULL AND preview_price != live_applied_price
GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY mismatches DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Tessa: result: artlab=2,340 mismatches (avg_delta 0.015), paletteco=310, sketchdesk=89. All line up with AB experiment rollout window.
Diego: mitigation: two short-term options: (A) have preview pipeline honor `X-Price-Override` for projection while in canary (matches live), or (B) have resolver stop emitting override until projection support is merged. I prefer A to avoid surprise billing.
Omar: agree A. But we must mark projection as \"canary-aware\" and make it explicit in console UI so PMs know projection includes transient override headers. Also need audit note in invoice history when overrides applied.
Tessa: will add metering.metric: price.override_applied_rate per-tenant and a dashboard card that splits \"projected\" vs \"live-applied\" by cause (override vs canonical mapping).
Diego: I'll open a small patch to preview pipeline to read override header from sampled raw events and apply same precedence logic as live. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1509 (draft)
ops-bot: applying temporary hold rule: pause further canary ramps if price.override_applied_rate > 0.5% for any tenant over 15m.
Omar: console UX: add a toggle on rollout page: \"Include transient price overrides in projection\" with an info tooltip. Also add an invoice banner if a tenant had >1% usage price-overrides in last 24h.
Tessa: follow-ups: (1) preview patch (Diego), (2) metric + dashboard (Tessa), (3) console toggle + banner (Omar), (4) backfill dry-run to estimate invoice delta if we retroactively applied overrides to preview for last 24h (Tessa + Diego).
Diego: backfill dry-run plan: sample 1% of raw events, re-run enrichment applying override precedence, produce diff report. If delta < $500 across tenants -> we won't backfill; otherwise staged apply. Will upload diffs to S3.
Omar: rollout gating snippet proposal to embed in canary config: 
```
rollout_checks:
  - metric: metering.price.override_applied_rate
    window: 900
    threshold_pct: 0.5
    action: hold
    note: \"prevent billing surprise from transient overrides\"
```
Tessa: also propose an automated note in tenant invoice preview that indicates when projection includes canary-only headers. That keeps transparency.
ops-bot: canary paused for route-resolver:v2-abtest (cr-2026-03-22-011) - hold reason: price.override_applied_rate exceeded threshold
Omar: assign owners: preview patch = Diego, metric/dashboard = Tessa, console UX = Omar. Keep canary paused until metric < 0.1% for 30m.
Diego: will push preview patch to staging and report results.
Omar: thanks all. Filing quick postmortem checklist in the rollout ticket: must validate pricing-impact projection before routing changes that can alter price precedence. Closing thread; will reopen with S3 diff + PR links.
